name: Appointments Booking for WPForms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/appointment-booking/
Pro Verion: https://add-ons.org/plugin/appointment-booking-field-for-wpforms-pro/
Document: https://add-ons.org/booknow-appointments-booking-addon-for-wpforms/

WpForms Appointments Booking Plugin, is a great and user-friendly tool to create an appointment booking system. Schedule appointments in just minutes.

The Appointment Booking For WPForms plugin allows you to easily create and manage online appointment bookings directly from your website. Combining the power of WPForms – a popular form builder plugin – with a professional booking system, it provides a seamless booking experience for your customers.

Simple Appointment Booking Form

Quickly create custom forms for appointment bookings with fields for name, email, phone number, and appointment time.

Flexible Date and Time Selection

Customers can select their preferred appointment time from available slots with an intuitive date and time picker.

Automatic Confirmation and Reminders

After a customer books an appointment, the system sends automatic confirmation emails and reminder notifications ahead of the scheduled time.

Google Calendar Integration

Sync appointments directly with Google Calendar, making it easier to manage and track your schedule.

Customizable Form Design

Easily customize the look and feel of the booking form to match your website’s branding.

Simple Appointment Management

Administrators can view and manage all appointments from the WordPress dashboard, making scheduling and tracking hassle-free

Payment Integration

Supports integration with payment gateways like PayPal and Stripe, enabling you to charge for appointments if needed.

Saves Time and Effort

Automates the process of booking appointments, reducing the need to manually confirm bookings via phone or email, which saves you time and increases operational efficiency.

Improves User Experience

Customers can book appointments at any time without needing to contact you directly, improving satisfaction and customer service.

Enhances Professionalism

With automated reminders and a polished interface, the plugin helps enhance your business’s professional image and build trust with clients

The Appointment Booking For WPForms plugin is the ideal solution for anyone looking to provide an easy-to-use, efficient appointment booking system directly on their WordPress site. Whether you’re a freelancer, a small business owner, or a service provider, this plugin streamlines the booking process and enhances your overall customer experience.

sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the pdf-for–wpforms.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the pdf-for-wpforms.zip directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
